explanation: Fixed preposition: 'good at' a subject or skill.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: By next year, I ___ my degree.
explanation: 'By + future time' needs the future perfect tense.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: They have been living here ___ 2015.
explanation: 'Since' is used with a point of time; 'for' with a duration.

subject: English
q: Identify the part of speech of 'brave' in 'He is a brave boy.':
explanation: 'Brave' describes the noun 'boy', so it is an adjective.

subject: English
q: Choose the correct synonym of CANDID:
explanation: Candid = frank and straightforward.

subject: English
q: Choose the correct antonym of EXPAND:
explanation: Expand = grow larger; contract = shrink.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: She was angry ___ me for my mistake.
explanation: 'Angry with' a person; 'angry at' a thing.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: He said that he ___ the match yesterday.
explanation: In indirect speech, past simple shifts to past perfect.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: ___ honest man is always respected.
explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'The train ___ (leave) at 6 o'clock tomorrow.'
explanation: Timetables and fixed schedules use present simple: 'leaves'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (write) a letter now.'
explanation: 'Now' signals present continuous: 'is writing'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (know) him since 2015.'
explanation: 'Since' with a state verb takes present perfect: 'have known'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (work) in this office since 2018.'
explanation: 'Since 2018' with an action verb takes present perfect continuous.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'Look at the clouds! It ___ (rain).'
explanation: Clear evidence now of a near-future event takes 'is going to rain'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (always/complain) about the food.'
explanation: A repeated annoying habit takes present continuous with 'always'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'The meeting ___ (start) at 10 a.m. yesterday.'
explanation: 'Yesterday' signals past simple: 'started'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (visit) my grandmother every Sunday when I was a child.'
explanation: A finished past habit takes past simple: 'visited'.

subject: English
q: Choose the synonym of 'Conspicuous'.
explanation: 'Conspicuous' means clearly visible: 'discernible'.

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'It took me ages to find a space ___ park my car.'
explanation: 'Space to park' takes the infinitive 'to'.

subject: English
q: Change the voice: 'She wrote a letter.'
options: A letter is written by her.
A letter has been written by her.
A letter was written by her.
A letter was wrote by her.
explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.

subject: English
q: Change the voice: 'They will build a new school.'
options: A new school will build by them.
A new school would be built by them.
A new school will be built by them.
A new school is built by them.
explanation: Future passive: will be + past participle.

subject: English
q: Change the voice: 'The teacher praised him.'
options: He had been praised by the teacher.
He has been praised by the teacher.
He is praised by the teacher.
He was praised by the teacher.
explanation: Past simple passive keeps the past tense: 'was praised'.

subject: English
q: Change the voice: 'Do not open the door.'
options: Let the door not be opened.
Let the door not be open.
Do not let the door opened.
explanation: Negative imperative passive: Let + object + not be + past participle.

subject: English
q: Change the voice: 'He is painting the wall.'
options: The wall has been painted by him.
The wall is being painted by him.
The wall is painted by him.
The wall was being painted by him.
explanation: Present continuous passive: is/am/are + being + past participle.

subject: English
q: He said, 'I am busy now.' Mark the correct indirect speech:
options: He said that he is busy now.
He told that he was busy now.
He said that he was busy then.
He said that he had been busy then.
explanation: Present simple shifts to past simple; 'now' becomes 'then'.

subject: English
q: The teacher said, 'Sit down, boys.' Mark the correct indirect speech:
options: The teacher requested the boys to sit down.
The teacher ordered the boys to sit down.
The teacher told the boys sit down.
The teacher said the boys to sit down.
explanation: An order is reported with 'ordered' + object + to-infinitive.

subject: English
q: He said, 'I saw her yesterday.' Mark the correct indirect speech:
options: He said that he saw her yesterday.
He told that he had seen her yesterday.
He said that he had seen her the previous day.
He said that he has seen her the previous day.
explanation: Past simple shifts to past perfect; 'yesterday' becomes 'the previous day'.

subject: English
q: He said, 'I have finished my work.' Mark the correct indirect speech:
options: He said that he had finished his work.
He said that he finished his work.
He told that he had finished his work.
He said that he has finished his work.
explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect in indirect speech.

subject: English
q: He said to me, 'Do you know the answer?' Mark the correct indirect speech:
options: He said to me if I knew the answer.
He asked me if I knew the answer.
He asked me do I know the answer.
He asked me that I knew the answer.
explanation: A yes/no question is reported with 'asked' + if/whether and the tense shifts back.

q: Fill in the blank: 'The news ___ not true.'

q: Fill in the blank: 'Many a student ___ absent today.'

subject: English
q: Fill in the blank: 'Fifty rupees ___ a small amount.'
explanation: An amount of money is treated as singular: 'is'.

explanation: A doctor treats a patient as a teacher teaches a student.
